supported_claims.text: 国 means “country” and is a simplified form of 國. Its outer enclosure survives from the older form, but 玉 has replaced the inner 或. To understand the character historically, keep that replacement in view: the older enclosure marked territory and 或 provided sound.
An older meaning-and-sound compound has undergone component replacement. 國 combines enclosure and phonetic 或; 国 substitutes 玉, concealing that sound relationship.
